description: Mark a receipt as a partial payment: the document covers more than this one payment (a deposit or instalment against a larger invoice), so its total differing from the transaction amount is expected. Replaces the `amount_mismatch` review reason with `partial_payment` so the receipt stops warning; the flag survives a reparse. Does not change any amounts. Check with the user first; only use it when get_receipt shows an amount mismatch the user confirms is intentional.

receiptId.description: Receipt id to mark (from list_receipts output).

name: mark_receipt_partial_payment
